note: Design round 10 (v12-totem.md 3.0-3.5), the call at 0, the option picked on 2026-11-03: call-pop-gold. rows are copied from the design's totem-call.json verbatim, as build-10.mjs drew them after the picks with the owner's two amendments (3.0): alone, the idol is centred in its well (form A: the wings around a two-cell face with a • eye in each half); beside its mark it shifts left (form B: the picked cells, the ¨ eyes, and the mark in the well's last cell: the last day's yellow ! or the pop's white ✦); and no count is ever drawn on the totem, as a Totem of Undying does not stack, so r-two and l-two-23h carry exactly the totem cells of r-safe and l-safe-23h. Each row is the full HUD (5 lines, roles top, hearts, xp, hot, edge): dist/hungerbar.mjs rendering the situation's payload in the media rig's sandbox (scripts/media/rig.mjs, the normal day of scripts/media/scenes/looks.mjs with hud.pr on, align left, user off) with hud.totem off, then the option painted onto the feature's cells by the moves of design 2.2; spaces are U+00A0, as Hungerbar prints them. situations are the design's inputs: the 5-hour window's used %, the week (60% left), the credits, the totems declared (n, kind, ends in hours), ctx.pop (the age of the pop in seconds: 0 it fell now, 30 over; null no fall seen) and ctx.until (the reset's end, epoch seconds). test/unit/hud-totem.test.ts renders each through Hungerbar with hud.totem on and the totems declared, and compares span for span.
name: Pop, then stay gold
optionNote: For 30 s from a fall seen live, the ✦ (white) in the well's last cell, the idol shifted left (form B), and gold sides; then the gold sides stay while the window is at 0 and a totem is held, and the idol re-centres (form A). The gold says "use it now".
title: The call at 0
intro: When a limit the totem can refill hits 0, the totem is in your offhand and the call begins. These options decide what it looks like at that moment and after. The pop's ✦ takes the well's last cell for its 30 s, the idol shifted left; after it the idol re-centres, or the last-day mark comes back. Drawn with the recommended shape, the golden idol.
